episodes.153919: A cluster of thunderstorms developed ahead of a cold front, from the Brevard County coast to 25 miles offshore. Wind gusts near 35 knots were observed near the coast north of Port Canaveral and also at a weather buoy 25 miles east of Port Canaveral.
episodes.153979: Low pressure system moving across the Southeastern U.S. with cold front extending into the Gulf of Mexico causes thunderstorms producing straight-line wind damage.
episodes.154867: A series of strong Pacific fronts moved across the region bringing high winds to the coast with heavy rain across much of the area. The heavy rains resulted in flooding of some coastal rivers as well as small stream flooding and a debris flow.

events.narrative: Buoy 41009, located 25 miles east of Port Canaveral recorded a peak wind gust of 35 knots from the south as a thunderstorm moved quickly northeast across the platform.

events.narrative: USAF wind tower 0403 at the Kennedy Space Center, located near the Banana River north of Port Canaveral, Recorded a peak gust of 35 knots from the southwest as a strong thunderstorm moved rapidly northeast across the barrier island and into the Atlantic.
